summary: The same rooms behind a session check, using the WebSocket Hibernation API with an automatic ping response, no timers, and a cap of 100 sockets per room.

must_not_flag.reason: Sockets are accepted through the Hibernation API, pings are answered by setWebSocketAutoResponse() without waking the object, and there is no timer, so a room with idle clients hibernates and is not billed for duration. Only members with a valid session can connect, and a room holds at most 100 sockets.
A message is only relayed to at most 99 other sockets. Outgoing messages are not billed, and nothing is written or called per message.
